items.title: Augustus – Open-source LLM Vulnerability Scanner With 210+ Attacks Across 28 LLM Providers
items.description: Augustus is a new open-source vulnerability scanner designed to secure Large Language Models (LLMs) against an evolving landscape of adversarial threats. Built by Praetorian, Augustus aims to bridge the gap between academic research tools and production-grade security testing, offering a single-binary solution that can launch over 210 distinct adversarial attacks against 28 LLM providers. items.title: Fortinet Patches Critical SQLi Flaw Enabling Unauthenticated Code Execution
